brief.title: Election update: Friday, November 6 (morning)
brief.markdown:
# Election update: Friday, November 6 (morning)

## Bottom line
The House results table now marks 409 of 435 races called: D 253, R 156, with 218 needed for a majority ([House table](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_United_States_House_of_Representatives_elections)). WKRN and the Nashville Banner both report Victoria Broderick (D) defeated Rep. Scott DesJarlais (R) in TN-04, a seat forecasters did not rate as competitive ([WKRN](https://news.google.?oc=5)). Counting that report, it is D 254, R 156. In the Senate, Democrats have secured 54 seats to Republicans' 44, counting seats not up, with 51 needed ([Senate table](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_United_States_Senate_elections)). Alaska and Mississippi are still uncalled, NPR reports ([NPR](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiekFVX3lxTFA3aWNXZThqQ3RhT3VwWGxOYXBsNWR2STNVNm9DTU1UaEUzN29vVzYyaW1HZEtOV3Fyb1lWS2xCb0VaRUlXYTFpSWN1c0FydEwwTWk4Z0h5NkRyWVVKODdWeWJQM09VenRNSjlkLWlrVWFzZnZXYmhOVE1R?oc=5)). No seat rated safe has a count within 5 points in the table, but the table has no vote shares yet.

## Called since the last update
- **ME-02 (Paul LePage, R gain):** marked called in the results table after Matt Dunlap (D) conceded, WMTW reports ([WMTW](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikgFBVV95cUxQdVFjcHdBSEhRZHFvbjZKVVZwTV9GWHZPWjRlSFF5LW1fQmJMTHZpRkUtemVobU5RZDVaTmFKbzJzU2l5RC1WWGZINEJ3bVgxcjVHVTNRQmxwTEpuTWh1WmlhREdhRTQ0Y1dUZXp1bHEyYXQ5SjNnajRmbzFSa1AxcHZDenUtMjFTRDRNLW1RRjcxZw?oc=5)). WABI reports ranked-choice tabulation will still proceed ([WABI](https://news.google.?oc=5)).
- Plus 1 safe seat called as rated (WA-04). No Senate race was called overnight, and no table call was reversed.

## Still uncalled
One line for every competitive race the table hasn't marked called, Senate first.
- **AK Senate** (Tossup): the Washington Post reports President Trump is demanding Sen. Dan Sullivan (R) be declared the winner while Mary Peltola (D) leads ([WaPo](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipwFBVV95cUxPM2lHMzhTTzJ3U09ONWJad2FlSDVDUXlNWnpLeXE4MUlLMUd0Vm4zSUlaaXY5NHVBVF9MaFVfN1BnZ2F5UnR0NlNaN2hFMDByY3FPbVF5c0NJbVJTeHBWNnlqb1lTN2pjSk1JeTVqc1pLNnFZTFNwbWNxLUNOa1lEdDJUWkc3Sy01U0ZNQmZza3RLdi1sVUZ4eHVLZEdFNW9SY0lCeFFmYw?oc=5)). An NYT analysis says ranked-choice ballots are unlikely to be enough for Sullivan ([NYT](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijgFBVV95cUxNcVRLN1RycFpYTXVqY1JiWlRCenpNSklRMDBBbTRvNVdvcktfLXEwb2lRYVY1dm5vd2FETVNibmNfNF9qaXM4U3A5RmtkbTVBUC0yR0dyeDJVeDJETThfUE9nOURlTU1XNFJpcGlRQnQtd0xpbWw2cE1TQXdLcEdMU0FaYXNSM25YWVh1dk5B?oc=5)).
- **MS Senate** (Likely R): CNN reports a growing fight over ballot counting ([CNN](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqgFBVV95cUxPYlJ6VXh1bDdaNC1SMUlrdFMySWN2RG9RMTZicHludXAySzVsUXhjaWwwS1g4S3dtUmtMekU2cS10d2VqbGtqT2diQVEzUFNCVnFRTFROTy1EUTdaX2xqSlRKRVU0YkVNekItR3JBR0ZOMXRjTXhVSkRRZ3NMMVluWXA1YjNxQUhvSDZGQW9pYlBneWM3QXYzTkdTLXpVRE9xaHhRdXBFZE01Zw?oc=5)), and the NYT reports votes are being carefully scrutinized ([NYT](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiwFBVV95cUxORnJiS25XRkxFY2xpdlB2R2wzVXBNYzJMdHZuN3B2OU8xVU9jUUJvd25DcDJrOHVOb0dXU3duRUtjMjB2NEcwWTF4NmZqSW93NnlZZURQRWVPak4xUG9VWXgwOWF4T1pYTWcxa1lPSzlzOGxpYjN2VEY1dXg2ZWItS0xtVnU4TzFadmZr?oc=5)).
